语言模型做电商搜索页面级布局决策

E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results. Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. item.description:

LOCAA：LLM 智能体在压缩回路中自动调优科学有损压缩器误差界，支持自定义目标与约束

Large-scale scientific simulations generate substantial data volumes, making lossy compression essential for reducing storage and data movement costs. However, users configure compressors through numerical error bounds (EBs) while often evaluating results using quality metrics and end-to-end performance. Because the relationship between an EB and these outcomes varies across datasets and compressors, identifying a suitable configuration typically requires exhaustive search, which can be time-consuming and computationally demanding. We present LOCAA, an Large language model-based scientific lossy compression auto-tuning agent that performs compression-in-the-loop search using tool-integrated execution, compressor-aware guidance, and persistent memory. LOCAA supports user-defined objectives and constraints without requiring a specialized search strategy. We evaluate LOCAA across three scientific applications, five compressors, and three use cases: fixed-ratio compression, compression tuning under multiple quality constraints, and compression tuning under quality and time constraints. For fixed-ratio search across twelve fields from two applications, LOCAA requires 1.98x fewer evaluat…

item.title: LLM Agents as Resilience Engineers for Scientific Applications
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

LLM 智能体作为科学应用的容错韧性工程师

Efficient checkpoint/restart support is essential for resilient HPC scientific applications, but implementing it requires substantial expertise: developers must identify recoverable state, choose globally consistent checkpoint points, and preserve application invariants during restart. We study whether frontier LLM coding agents can automate this process. We build a benchmark suite of 16 MPI applications spanning diverse domains, code sizes, and critical-state structures, and evaluate them with a no-human-in-the-loop generate--validate--revise pipeline for checkpoint/restart synthesis. Across the benchmark, the pipeline produces 41 working resilient implementations. Our results show that agent-driven resilience engineering is practical when critical state is visible or accessible through coherent abstractions: successful runs finish in under one hour on average, consume about 15M tokens, and produce implementations with negligible failure-free overhead and recovery efficiency comparable to human-written code. However, modularized and fragmented state remains a major limitation, with some failed attempts consuming over 100M tokens and 300 minutes without producing a working implemen…

item.title: Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 特征缓存加速扩散采样时，基于历史特征的预测无法感知当前去噪状态的变化。

方法 观察修正的 Koopman 框架：用校准轨迹识别浅层与深层网络特征增量的有限维时变 Koopman 近似；加速采样时算子预测昂贵深层特征的演化，新鲜计算的廉价浅层特征作为观测来修正预测状态；周期性全量评估刷新观察器，生成模型参数完全冻结。

关键数字 三个万图级实验：配对 Inception 特征 MSE 较逐通道仿射预测降 19.9%（CIFAR-10）/11.9%（ImageNet 十类子集），消融把其中 4.54%/4.67% 归于观测修正；较 DDIM-50 实测加速 1.89×/1.85×。

为什么值得看 把控制论的观察器思想干净地搬进扩散加速，免重训、带对照消融，方法学扎实。

item.title: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

Kernaut：构造契约保证有效性 + 质量多样性档案的开放式核函数自动发现

Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic…

item.title: KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现有 KV cache 压缩都按"内容与当前 query 的相关性"决定去留，但 cache 还有按位置顺序遍历的访问模式——逐字复制类任务（RAG、代码补全、结构化抽取）因此在中途不可逆地断掉，作者称之为顺序遗忘，且它是压缩下剩余质量损失的主因。

方法 KVFetch：免训练、即插即用，为任意打分型压缩器开启时间召回通道——被淘汰候选降级到量化冷层，用单调读指针检测活跃复制，把位置后继预取进定烧热层槽位，不增加注意力开销。

关键数字 RULER-16K 同预算下逐字复制从 0.8 恢复到 78.4，13 任务平均 +8.4；LongBench 无顺序访问需求时通道休眠、零开销。

为什么值得看 指出整个压缩领域的结构性盲区并给出零成本兜底，对所有 KV 压缩工作都有普适警示。

A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. item.title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

KGATE：模块化知识图谱自编码器训练环境库

Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: KDFP: A first-principles approach to knowledge distillation in large language models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 蒸馏研究大多聚焦后训练能力（指令跟随、思维链、工具使用），而面向边缘部署所需的通用知识蒸馏存在明显研究空白——这对构建高效、可私有部署的系统至关重要。

方法 KDFP 采取第一性原理方法：系统评估前人经验、开展新探索，形成适用于现代 LLM 的白盒通用知识蒸馏方法论，其中通过「临时参数削减」（ephemeral parameter reduction）大幅提升训练效率。

关键数字 在 9 个基准上比现有方法高 1.6%–4.9%；训练效率提升最高达 99.1%。

为什么值得看 把蒸馏拉回「通用知识」这个被忽视的基础赛道，训练效率近两个数量级的提升对想做小模型/端侧模型的人是实打实的工程利好。

item.description:

LLM 语义桥接的时空图节点生成框架 GenST，预测未部署传感器节点的状态

Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. item.title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

分布扩散的高效端到端短临降水预报

Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

输入盲扰动对照揭示层级程序 oracle 评估存在大量虚假余量

Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests…

item.title: Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

跨支架/表位的推理时转向做样本高效纳米抗体设计

Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

系统辨识in-context学习的概率化表述与长序列处理

Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. Third, we systematically evaluate the framework on stan…

系统辨识in-context学习的概率化表述与长序列处理

Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. item.title: Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

耗散知识动力学模型的可辨识性：设计激励下精确恢复、观测数据下退化

Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a concept-transfer matrix encoding prerequisite coupling, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. We prove a structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, with constructive closed-form recovery for the two-concept case, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive a semi-implicit L-stable scheme for the dissipative subsystem and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation (bit-exact predictions, gradients to $10^{-10}$) yet two orders of magnitude faster, making estimation feasible on cohorts of $10^5$ learners. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact: parameters to machine precision, prerequisite structure at…

纠删码存储系统中利用网内聚合增强的主动修复机制

Erasure-coded storage provides fault tolerance with substantially lower storage overhead than full replication, but repairing lost or at-risk blocks requires intensive cross-node data transfer. Existing reactive repair schemes start only after a failure, while proactive schemes can move data before failure but commonly treat migration, reconstruction, and network aggregation as loosely coupled operations. As a result, receiver?side bottlenecks, heterogeneous available bandwidth, and limited programmable-switch state continue to constrain repair paral?lelism. This paper presents IAPRepair, an in-network aggre?gation enhanced proactive repair framework for erasure-coded storage. IAPRepair jointly constructs each repair batch, assigns reconstruction providers and replacement nodes according to normalized transmission loads, schedules migration around the remaining receive capacity, and selectively enables in-network aggregation for reconstruction blocks that would otherwise over?load healthy nodes. The selective design reduces receiver-side traffic while retaining migration parallelism and respecting a configurable switch-resource budget. We implement IAPRepair with a Tofino programma…

item.title: Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

协同设计会议中人引导与LLM引导的计算行为比较

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). item.title: How Hackable Is Your Speech Quality Metric? A Corrected Protocol, a Benchmark, and What Patching Buys
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

语音质量度量可被黑掉：修正协议与基准及补丁收益

Speech quality predictors are increasingly used as rewards, yet no agreed measure of their hackability exists. The usual measurement has two flaws. First, the perturbation reaches the predictor through a processing chain -- here a neural codec -- that shifts the score on its own, which scoring against the raw input charges to the attack. Referencing the unperturbed round trip instead changes measured hackability by up to a factor of four (0.31 to 0.08 for one defence). Second, one trained attacker is a sample, not a measurement: five attackers differing only in random seed reach success rates from 0.00 to 0.38 against one fixed predictor, so a defence claim needs the worst case over several. Under this protocol, four published predictors differ widely: NISQA is hacked on 90% of utterances, SSL-MOS on 21%, DNSMOS on 14% and UTMOS on 6%. We then audit a closed attack-detect-patch loop. It hardens the predictor only in its own attack space, by less than the spread between attackers; a random-perturbation baseline matches it; and it costs up to 0.30 system SRCC out of domain. Enhancers post-trained against patched predictors hack them far less (PESQ -0.03 versus -0.23). Code, preregist…

item.title: How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

Transformer 通过有限数据增强学习对称性的可学习性排序研究

Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at https://transformers-learn-symmetries.githu…

item.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Demo of a Cooperative Intersection where Cars don't Stop
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

车辆不停车通过合作式路口的硬件在环演示

The road transportation sector is undergoing a radical transformation, working for a future where all vehicles will be autonomous and connected. A key challenge in this vision concerns intersections, which will no longer rely on traffic lights or traditional right-of-way rules. Instead, algorithms and communication protocols will be employed to optimize traffic flow. In this context, we are developing a testbed where cars equipped with wireless connectivity exchange information with a remote controller and coordinate their maneuvers. As the vehicles navigate through different types of intersections with various routes, they communicate with the controller, adjusting their speed to pass through intersections without stopping. This demo specifically showcases a hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) implementation of such intelligent intersection, using the SUMO traffic simulator to emulate vehicle positions. Real hardware and software components, which are designed for use in vehicles and roadside infrastructure, are employed to enable real-time data exchange of contextual and control information, running the cooperative coordination algorithm.

item.title: HPC-MQBench: Qualification-First Benchmarking on Slurm with a Single-Broker Kafka Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

HPC-MQBench：Slurm 编排的 HPC 消息队列基准，先资格审查再速率排名的单 broker Kafka 评测

Messaging experiments on high-performance computing clusters must coordinate services, clients, and measurement within scheduler allocations. We present HPC-MQBench, a Slurm-orchestrated benchmark that links resumable experiment control to record checks, delivery accounting, and qualification before rate ranking. Its Kafka evaluation placed producers/controller, one broker, consumers, and monitoring on four nodes. With memory-backed logs, 120 workload configurations yielded 99 qualified observations, 14 outside the producer-delivery policy, and seven with invalid evidence. Two validation stages each repeated ten workloads in five blocks. In the final stage, the selected workload qualified in all five observations, with medians of 2,927 mebibytes per second balanced endpoint rate, 1.24 percent pending deliveries, and 2.56 seconds for the 99th-percentile latency. It qualified in only two observations in the earlier stage, where qualification improved after an allocation boundary without establishing a causal allocation effect. Selection is conditional on the stage and delivery policy. Resource measurements did not isolate a unique bottleneck. The contribution is a framework for distr…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

混合Attention-RWKV时序基础模型，定位RWKV-7长程预测的状态衰减机制

Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. Motivated by this analysis, we propose HART, a Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model that alternates attention and RWKV blocks, combining direct access to historical tokens with recurrent temporal modeling. Controlled experiments on GIFT-Eval and TIME-Benchmark show that HART improves over pure RWKV at medium and long horizons while maint…

item.title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

GraphOPD：图增强的智能体在线策略蒸馏，修正多轮场景下按步分歧选择失效的问题

On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph,…

item.title: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

从散度视角统一LLM RL算法（广义近端策略优化）

Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. item.title: GPU-resident Execution for Timing-predictable Sensor Processing Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：闭环实时系统里 GPU 只做加速器、CPU 主机仍是每轮迭代的编排者——中断、调度与 CUDA API 开销让端到端延迟不可控，能否让 I/O 与执行全程驻留 GPU？ 方法：提出 GPU-resident Execution 执行模型：传感器输入直达 GPU 显存、触发 GPU 侧处理、到达 GPU 可见输出端点，全程无主机唤醒；在 NVIDIA Holoscan C++ 框架实现并提供参考组件。 关键数字：1080p/60 Hz 工业级相机到显示应用上，光子到显示抖动从 4.83 ms 降到 0.66 ms（7.3×），软件处理抖动从 1.70 ms 降到 0.01 ms（170×）（对比 CPU 驱动的 GPU 显存 RDMA 基线）。 为什么值得看：机器人/AR 等硬实时感知管线对「去主机化」需求强烈，这是 NVIDIA 官方框架背书的系统化答案。

研究问题：闭环实时系统里 GPU 只做加速器、CPU 主机仍是每轮迭代的编排者——中断、调度与 CUDA API 开销让端到端延迟不可控，能否让 I/O 与执行全程驻留 GPU？ 方法：提出 GPU-resident Execution 执行模型：传感器输入直达 GPU 显存、触发 GPU 侧处理、到达 GPU 可见输出端点，全程无主机唤醒；在 NVIDIA Holoscan C++ 框架实现并提供参考组件。 关键数字：1080p/60 Hz 工业级相机到显示应用上，光子到显示抖动从 4.83 ms 降到 0.66 ms（7.3×），软件处理抖动从 1.70 ms 降到 0.01 ms（170×）（对比 CPU 驱动的 GPU 显存 RDMA 基线）。 为什么值得看：机器人/AR 等硬实时感知管线对「去主机化」需求强烈，这是 NVIDIA 官方框架背书的系统化答案。

item.title: Fully Interpretable Minimal Transformers: From Geometry to Algorithm
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

完全可解释的极简 Transformer：2 维嵌入直接可视化内部算法

We present a framework for building and interpreting minimal transformer models. By constraining a transformer's embedding dimension and head size to 2, we enable full two-dimensional visualization of its internal representations. Embeddings, query/key/value transforms, attention outputs, residual streams, and decision boundaries can all be seen directly. Our central claim is that the learned geometry implies an algorithm; the arrangement of points and boundaries in R^2 can be read as a step-by-step procedure. We train a transformer on a simple task where it must produce the most recently observed even number whenever the '+' operator appears in a sequence of digits. Once trained, we visually walk through every step of the transformer's computation. We show how the model embeds the tokens and their respective positions in the sequence, transforms them via the Q, K, and V matrices, uses the dot product between the Q and K representations to form the attention matrix, and uses the attention matrix to select values that move the representation of each input token to the region of the domain of the output layer that will correctly predict the next token. item.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

演化功能曲目实现 LLM 持续学习

Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average perfo…

item.title: From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

LLM 生成规则再组织成决策树的少样本表格分类

While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 比较参数高效微调配方时共用单一学习率是个普遍但有缺陷的做法：当被比较的分支可训练参数量差异很大时，共享学习率会同时压低大分支的均值并放大方差，给最小的分支制造出看似多随机种子显著、实则虚假的优势。

方法 以事后 SVD 式 KV 缓存压缩为具体场景做剖析：预训练模型的键/值权重被分解为下投影（编码器）与上投影（解码器），短时微调（「healing」）恢复截断损失。共享学习率下「冻结解码器、只修复编码器」看似明显更优；给每个分支独立调学习率后该优势消失，编码器修复仅与其它方案持平。经逐分支调学习率、每配置三个随机种子在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 上验证，并在文本测试台跨两个骨干复现。

关键数字 编码器单侧修复实打实省 3 倍可训练参数与 3 倍优化器状态内存。

为什么值得看 结论本身是低显存 KV 压缩配方的实用结论，更可贵的是把「共享学习率比较」这一方法论陷阱记录在案，对所有微调配方对比实验都是警示。

item.title: FinVector-Market-4B: A Controlled Study of LoRA Adaptation for Structured Financial Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

LoRA 适配 Qwen3.5-4B 的金融结构化任务受控研究：schema 显式化与基线复审计

FinVector-Market-4B adapts Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B with rank-16 LoRA on a 22,000-example corpus for structured financial tasks. We evaluate the base and adapted models on the same 600-example benchmark under implicit and explicit JSON-schema contracts. Supplying the schema alone raises base-model JSON validity from 0% to 91.3%. Under matched explicit prompting, the frozen scores improve from 14.7% to 40.0% for FinQA answer exact match, from 48.0% to 82.7% for calculator-expression correctness, from 20.1% to 89.5% for scenario branch-label agreement, and from 52.4% to 87.2% for implication-direction agreement. A post-hoc policy-scoring audit shows that the reported macro-F1 decline reflects a changing label set; using the same three target classes gives 77.4% for the base and 83.1% for the adapter. Filing overlap and calculator-target inconsistencies qualify the benchmark's generalization claims. The results show that compact financial domain adaptation can produce substantial task-specific gains beyond output-format learning under matched prompting, with gains bounded by the evaluated task distribution and prompt contract.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization with Direction Aggregation and Variance Reduction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 联邦环境下客户端只能拿到随机函数评估（零阶信息）的受约束非光滑非凸优化如何高效求解？现有联邦零阶方法主要做「本地零阶更新 + 模型平均」，受本地投影更新带来的客户端漂移与随机零阶估计的采样方差困扰。

方法 提出基于方向聚合的联邦零阶框架，配两种本地采样方案：FedZOO 用跨多次球面查询共享的小批量构造本地方向，同时控制数据采样与梯度近似的随机误差；FedVRZO 用独立的「样本-方向」对构造本地估计，其采样误差直接由对数控制。两种算法中，客户端对本地投影轨迹上评估出的方向取均值，服务器用客户端方向的加权聚合做一次投影更新。两者均给出收敛保证。

关键数字 在黑盒对抗攻击实验上验证有效性；摘要未给出具体量化数字。

为什么值得看 无梯度联邦优化给了收敛性保证的系统化方案，做联邦学习理论、黑盒优化的读者可以直接对照两种采样设计的误差控制差异。

item.title: FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

FedRSPO+：异构下游目标感知的决策聚焦联邦学习算法

Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models for downstream optimization, but existing methods largely assume centralized data. In cross-silo settings, federated learning offers a natural alternative, yet standard federated methods optimize prediction over decision quality and do not address heterogeneity in downstream objectives or feasible sets. This heterogeneity is especially challenging for DFL because small perturbations in polyhedral problems can cause discontinuous changes in optimal decisions, destabilizing client updates and aggregation. We propose FedRSPO+, a heterogeneity-aware framework for decision-focused federated learning, built on RSPO+, a regularized predict-then-optimize surrogate that smooths the decision map through projection. We show that RSPO+ upper bounds decision error and regret for the regularized decision and, under exact regularization and consistent LP solution selection, for the original LP decision. We further derive cross-client heterogeneity bounds that depend on both objective and feasible-set heterogeneity, vanish at homogeneity, and require no strong convexity. item.title: FedPCD: Priority-Constrained Federated Aggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

优先级约束的联邦聚合（FedPCD）

Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. Across heterogeneous FL benchmarks, FedPCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the highest global accuracy across all configurations and leading worst-10% client accuracy in nearly all. FedPCD further preserves competitive trade-offs between global accuracy and client performance variability. Beyond this trade-off, FedPCD demonstrates faster e…

item.title: Fast and Memory Efficient Offload Training Framework with Hybrid XPU Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 ZeRO-Offload 把优化器状态搬到 CPU 缓解显存不足，但存在 GPU 利用率低、通信计算重叠不完美、offload 不灵活等缺陷。

方法 利用 GPU 的 Direct Host Access（DHA）直接计算 CPU 内存中的数据，形成 GPU 加 DHA 的混合计算：调度器选择哪些参数层走 DHA、其余同时传入显存以缩短前向，反向时再把 DHA 参数载入显存；shadow model 提供统一内存抽象；动态规划算法把梯度也经 DHA offload；ScaleUp-MemFerry 再利用 scale-up 互联带宽做自适应多路径传输。

关键数字 单卡训练最快 1.68×、可训模型大 1.52×（对比 ZeRO-Offload）；8 卡数据并行提速至少 28.1%；华为 CloudMatrix384 上端到端迭代时间较 DeepSpeed 最多降 20.7%。

为什么值得看 DHA 这一少被利用的硬件能力被用出系统级收益，且已在国产 scale-up 节点验证。

item.title: Exploiting Gradients in Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

昂贵模拟器贝叶斯推断中的梯度利用

Simulators based on differential equations are ubiquitous in science and engineering. They are often used in simulation-based inference to evaluate the posterior distribution of the input parameters based on real-world observations of the simulator outputs. However, inference becomes challenging when individual simulator evaluations are computationally expensive. In such cases, a Bayesian optimization-based active learning approach with Gaussian process surrogate models has been used to maximize the information obtained from a limited simulation budget. Recently, gradients of simulator outputs with respect to input parameters have become increasingly available, yet they are rarely exploited for inference. Even though we only need to learn the simulator input-output relationship, gradient information can provide an additional valuable signal to guide the active learning procedure. 解释对抗训练网络显著性图稀疏性的来源

Understanding why deep neural networks make a given prediction is of great importance for their safe deployment. In computer vision, saliency maps, which highlight the image region most influential for a prediction, remain a widely-used form of explanation. An empirical observation is the apparent sparsity of gradient saliency maps of adversarially-trained neural networks. In this paper, we propose a theoretical explanation of this phenomenon for two-layer ReLU networks. We build on the established equivalence of adversarial training to the minimization of the empirical risk with weight-decay penalization and an added adversarial total variation term -- valid for certain loss functions. As the number of data points and neurons grows and the regularization parameters are sent to zero at appropriate rates, we prove that minimizers converge to a Bayes classifier with minimal gradient and Barron norm. Sparsity appears since for adversarial training with $\ell_\infty$-attacks the gradient norm is anisotropic and favors axis-aligned / sparse gradients. item.title: Execution-Feasible Dispatch of LLM Pre-training Loads for Renewable-Dominant AI Data Centers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

将LLM预训练负载映射为checkpoint域3D并行可行模式，纳入可再生主导数据中心的日前电力调度

AI data centers (AIDCs) are emerging as large power-system loads, making their operational flexibility increasingly valuable. Existing studies often treat AIDC demand as continuously adjustable or generically delay-tolerant, which overstating the flexibility of large language model (LLM) pretraining. This paper proposes an execution-feasible dispatch framework for LLM pre-training in renewable-dominant AIDCs. LLM descriptors are first converted into checkpoint-domain daily workloads, then mapped to feasible 3D-parallel GPU modes with explicit throughput, GPU-capacity, memory, and IT-power limits. The resulting checkpoint- and mode-constrained load states are embedded into a day-ahead power dispatch model. Case studies on a 2048 GPUs AIDC with two LLaMA pretraining tasks show that checkpoint-aware 3D dispatch reduces operating cost by 20.02% and renewable curtailment from 1.077 to 0.014 MWh relative to fixed continuous training. Related results also show that checkpoint records alone do not create load flexibility,practical grid-interactive flexibility arises from checkpoint waiting combined with execution-feasible 3D-mode compensation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

固定权重线性注意力 Transformer 精确执行因果结构学习迭代

Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. item.title: Exact SO(3)-Equivariant Isotropic Kernels for Rotation-Robust Neural Dynamics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

旋转鲁棒神经动力学的精确 SO(3) 等变各向同性核

Neural surrogates for vector-valued partial differential equations can fit training data yet change their predictions when the same physical state is expressed in a rotated coordinate frame. We study this failure on three-dimensional Navier--Stokes dynamics observed at irregularly placed points. We introduce the Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator (IKNO), a compact graph model that builds local interactions from scalar quantities unchanged by rotation and vector directions that rotate with the data. Consequently, rotating the positions and velocities rotates the predicted velocity change in exactly the same way. On a held-out test set fixed after model design, training unconstrained graph models on randomly rotated examples reduces but does not eliminate their coordinate dependence. In contrast, IKNO is consistent to numerical precision, matches the forecasting accuracy of a general rotation-aware Tensor Field Network with $5.6$ times fewer parameters, and outperforms a parameter-matched graph simulator. These results show that a compact, PDE-specialized model can remove coordinate dependence without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.

item.title: EvoSignal: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Design of Modular Traffic Signal Control Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

EvoSignal：LLM 引导进化设计模块化交通信号控制程序

Effective traffic signal control (TSC) requires policies that respond to changing traffic demand and network conditions while meeting different control objectives. However, adapting existing strategies often involves repeated manual design and adjustment, making it difficult to systematically explore better control rules for a target network. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but directly using them to select signal phases leaves decision rules embedded in black-box models and incurs recurring inference costs and latency. This paper formulates TSC as a modular program design problem and proposes EvoSignal, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework using traffic knowledge and performance feedback. The modular representation separates traffic feature extraction, local phase prioritization, and optional network-based priority adjustment. Starting from several established strategies, EvoSignal improves programs through feedback on congestion and signal operation, retaining strategies with different performance trade-offs. The resulting programs operate without online LLM inference. Simulation experiments across five scenarios on two real-world road networks show that t…

item.title: Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

Dempster-Shafer融合的循证多模态transformer情感识别

Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imb…

item.title: Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

GNN 反欺诈的难区域引导虚拟节点证据注入

Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Cruc…

item.description:

终层注意力路由的轨迹特征评估：六个预设比较经族校正后均无正收益

Attention routing requires a signal that predicts the value of attention on the current prefix. We evaluate whether hidden-state extrapolation error, curvature and error change improve this prediction beyond uncertainty, one-step displacement, position and state projections. Paired executions of the final attention layer supply signed next-token loss differences in frozen SmolLM3-3B-Base and Qwen3.5-4B-Base checkpoints. Utility-supervised routers are tested on 100 held-out PG-19 books at an identical causal 20 percent invocation quota. None of six prespecified comparisons shows a positive gain after familywise correction. In Qwen3.5, a parameter-matched fixed-projection control lowers NLL by 0.00356 nats/token relative to the trajectory router (95 percent interval 0.00218 to 0.00487). Secondary results depend on the operation removed, feature location and scoring horizon; frozen thresholds also drift substantially at longer horizons. Actual selected-query execution yields small long-sequence latency reductions with increased NLL, while learned routers remain slower during cached continuation. item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 prefill 中期剪枝可缩短深层 transformer 处理的序列，但注意力集中度本身无法证明被丢弃的上下文真的可有可无。

方法 纯理论框架 EntroPrefill：Renyi 引导的提案机制叠加对丢弃注意力质量的显式约束；推导 mixture-to-head 删除包络（可计算的 token 删除上界）、剪枝层自适应选择时仍成立的有限样本观察器保证，以及带显式 Lipschitz 常数的条件扰动界；并用反例说明浅层观察不能蕴含无条件未来输出保证。

关键数字 本文不报告实测加速或精度保持数字：给出剪枝的算术盈亏平衡条件，实验验证明确留待后续工作。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

注意力非线性中涌现的逆深度缩放现象

Scaling laws describe power-law improvements in model performance with dataset size and parameter count, yet their underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To explain the parameter count scaling, existing theory posits power-law scaling with model depth. In linear-attention models, this scaling is tied to a power-law data spectrum: unable to selectively attend to relevant tokens, these models learn according to global spectral strength, with stronger directions learned before weaker ones. Large language models, however, can be strongly nonlinear. Here, we show that nonlinear attention yields inverse-depth decay of loss across all tested data spectra. Nonlinearity enables attention to focus selectively on relevant tokens, allowing strong and weak spectral directions to be learned in parallel. Similar focusing across layers motivates a connection to the central limit theorem: shared error across layers sets the loss plateau, while aggregation turns layer-specific differences into continued gains with depth. item.title: Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

PrivTab：架构内嵌差分隐私机制、免每数据集优化的表格基础模型

Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces…

PrivTab：架构内嵌差分隐私机制、免每数据集优化的表格基础模型

Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces…

item.title: Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

EfficientAD 与 DDPM 分数融合的晶圆 bin 图开集异常检测

Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. item.title: Efficient Heuristics and Machine Learning Approach for Fault Characterization in Distributed Self-Stabilizing Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

分布式自稳定程序一致性违例故障（cvf）的启发式与机器学习特征化方法

Modern large-scale systems rely on distributed protocols to maximize efficiency while preserving the correctness guarantees of single-process execution. However, designing such protocols is non-trivial: adding resources to a system inherently increases its complexity, which in turn introduces faults that must be addressed during design. One such fault class, arising in systems that use distributed shared memory (e.g., replicated databases), is consistency violating fault (cvf), a fault in which a process accessing shared memory reads stale data previously written by another process. Cvfs are inherent to systems that prioritize availability over strict consistency. Prior work has shown that self-stabilizing programs remain correct under high availability, provided such faults stay within a tolerable bound. Characterizing the behavior of self-stabilizing programs in the presence of cvfs can therefore help system designers build systems that are both correct and efficient. In this paper, we study self-stabilizing programs under cvfs to understand when and where such faults occur, enabling runtime measures that improve computational efficiency. item.title: Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

Best-of-N 策略的免似然高效评估框架（双稳健估计与共享辅助样本池）

Best-of-N (BoN) is a common inference-time alignment method that selects the highest-scoring response among N samples from a reference model. Evaluating BoN policies from logged data is challenging under sample-only access because standard off-policy estimators require density ratios that depend on unavailable response likelihoods. In this paper, we propose a sample-only framework for evaluating and selecting BoN policies without access to these likelihoods. We show that the order-statistic structure of BoN allows the required density ratios to be expressed through score-rank probabilities that are estimable from samples alone. We then develop a doubly robust estimator of the BoN policy value (BoN-DR) that efficiently reuses a shared auxiliary sample pool across candidate budgets. We establish valid asymptotic inference even under reward estimator misspecification and prove the efficiency of our BoN-DR estimator. Since larger budgets can amplify errors in the score function and lead to reward overoptimization, we derive two selection rules: (i) maximizing the estimated policy value and (ii) maximizing a lower confidence bound on the improvement over the reference policy, which acco…

item.title: Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

动力学预测学到的图结构迁移到逆问题系统性失效的实证与理论分析

A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $Δ< n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+Δ)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two f…

item.title: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

从盆几何与循环去噪看扩散模型记忆的早期特征

Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also revea…

item.title: EDiS: Edge Disjoint Subgraph Sparsification Framework for Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

EDiS：一次结构提取+逐 epoch 重组的 GNN 边不相交子图稀疏化框架

Sparse GNN training reduces computation, but deciding which edges to keep can be costly. Reusing one sparse graph is cheap, but locks training to a fixed topology, while varying it across epochs can require repeated sampling or recomputation. We introduce EDiS (Edge-Disjoint Subgraph sparsification framework), which separates one-time structural extraction from per-epoch graph composition. EDiS decomposes the graph once into cacheable edge-disjoint subgraphs, then recombines them into graphs with edge-budget constraints across epochs and retention ratios without re-extracting structure. Our default construction uses feature-based scores and successive maximum score covering forests, while the same composition mechanism also supports alternative edge selection rules. We provide a combinatorial analysis of the per-epoch sampler, the composition step that draws a training graph from the cached decomposition. We show that, under the default covering-forest selector, the stored decomposition deterministically preserves high-score cut edges, and we derive a selector-agnostic conditional bound on high-score cut survival in composed training graphs. item.title: Dynamics as Code: On Model Compression via Dynamic System
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 预训练模型越来越大，压缩成为严苛内存/算力约束下部署的前置条件。此前提出的「动力系统（DS）」范式把压缩重构为紧凑权重表示：高维参数用动力系统产生的一条轨迹的索引来编码，解压时再恢复向量——机制上与剪枝、量化、蒸馏、低秩分解都不同。

方法 该文沿此方向证明：在 Diophantine 条件下，无理环绕中 M = O(ε^-(d+ν)) 个状态的有限轨迹构成 d 维权重空间的 ε-网，从而把状态分辨率、解压误差与压缩比联系起来。进而统一四类动力系统家族（Hilbert/Peano/Morton/Snake 空间填充曲线、Lorenz 混沌系统、LCG/PCG 同余伪随机数、Halton 低差异序列），引入 KD 树与坐标模板加速以扩展到大模型，外加离群点识别控制误差。

关键数字 在 ResNet-18 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B / Qwen1.5-7B 上验证：无需事后重训练即可获得有竞争力的压缩比，解压误差可控；摘要未给出具体压缩比数值。

为什么值得看 理论保证 + 可落地的完整框架，给模型压缩提供了一条与主流四件套正交的新路线。

item.title: DynaTE: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Dynamic Token Execution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）能双向并行细化、缓解自回归解码的串行瓶颈，但其并行迭代细化与面向顺序解码的 AR 加速器不匹配，现有 dLLM 加速器又把所有 token 一并保留执行，忽视各 token 细化价值与执行需求的差异。

方法 DynaTE 是软硬件协同架构，让加速器执行随解码中的 token 状态动态适配：跳过低价值 token 计算实现自适应执行，维度可重构 PE 阵列在不同活跃 token 模式下维持高利用率；通过 FLDD 在当前迭代内细化少量局部依赖 token 以减少去噪迭代轮数，Merge-Split-Merge 数据流隐藏串行开销；流式词表引擎交错处理 LM head 的多 token 流。

关键数字 在两个代表性 dLLM 上，比现有最先进 dLLM 加速器快 2.05–2.78 倍、能效高 2.99–3.93 倍；比 Jetson AGX Orin 快 2.55 倍、能效高 6.07 倍。

为什么值得看 dLLM 推理加速尚属早期，这是「按 token 状态动态调度」方向的代表作，做新范式推理硬件的同学值得细读。

item.title: DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 服务为专家精度「付两次钱」——常驻占用按所有可达专家计费、每步解码只读被选专家；现有每专家分配器只约束了前者，「存-读差距」怎么补？ 方法：DuoRate「一次存储、按负载读取」：离线存一层统一前缀可读权流并烘焙畸变张量；在线用自身 prefill 无标签剖析，在解码泛函下解拉格朗日率失真分配（路由频率在各专家决策中可证消去），每专家一个点积 + 一次二分。 关键数字：BitsMoE 检查点存 2.54 bpw 读时 7.50 bpw；Qwen3-30B-A3B 上 2.3 bpw 读取超所有 2-bit 档基线 6.3~47.0 点；2.9 bpw 下 GSM8K 与 BF16 只差 0.25 点；分配本身值 0.07~0.11 bpw 读率。 为什么值得看：把存储率与读取率拆开优化的视角很新，长解码 MoE 服务的量化部署可直接抄作业。

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 服务为专家精度「付两次钱」——常驻占用按所有可达专家计费、每步解码只读被选专家；现有每专家分配器只约束了前者，「存-读差距」怎么补？ 方法：DuoRate「一次存储、按负载读取」：离线存一层统一前缀可读权流并烘焙畸变张量；在线用自身 prefill 无标签剖析，在解码泛函下解拉格朗日率失真分配（路由频率在各专家决策中可证消去），每专家一个点积 + 一次二分。 关键数字：BitsMoE 检查点存 2.54 bpw 读时 7.50 bpw；Qwen3-30B-A3B 上 2.3 bpw 读取超所有 2-bit 档基线 6.3~47.0 点；2.9 bpw 下 GSM8K 与 BF16 只差 0.25 点；分配本身值 0.07~0.11 bpw 读率。 为什么值得看：把存储率与读取率拆开优化的视角很新，长解码 MoE 服务的量化部署可直接抄作业。

item.title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：原生 4-bit 硬件上要权重和激活同时低比特才有吞吐红利，但激活量化通常需要校准数据——能否免校准地做 W4A4？ 方法：DUALQUANT 直接最小化权重重建 MSE，其副产品天然给出按通道的激活重缩放；把问题表述为不可微的权重重建，用变量分裂 + 块坐标下降求解（子问题闭式更新），统一支持 MX 家族与 NVFP4 等块格式。 关键数字：Llama/Qwen 在 WikiText-2、C4 与零样本任务上，多数模型与格式持平或超过基于校准的 SmoothQuant；RTX 4090 上 Llama-3.1-8B 真实打包 W4A4 推理较 BF16 内存最高降 2.61×、吞吐最高 2.46×。 为什么值得看：据称是首个正式支持 MX 与 NV 块格式的双尺度免校准方法，落点正是当前推理芯片的主流格式。

item.title: Dual-QK: Sharp Queries and Flat Keys for Prunable 2-bit KV Caches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 KV cache 低比特量化加 query 通道剪枝可省存储与读量，但旋转式量化要求同一正交变换同时施加到 query，会打散 query 能量，削弱"少数大分量保留、多数小分量剪枝"所需的分离度。

方法 Dual-QK 用成对的非正交 query/key 变换化解冲突：部分 key 白化加 query 对齐基，既平衡 INT2 量化的 key 尺度，又把 query 能量集中起来支持动态通道剪枝；另配 channel-0 保护与 bucket 相对 RoPE 保住长上下文低比特精度。

关键数字 128K 上下文下 6.8× KV cache 压缩、KV 读量估计降 8.3×（相对未剪枝 BF16）；40% query 通道稀疏下多数任务优于 OSCAR；SGLang 实现解码吞吐最高 3.75×。

为什么值得看 把量化与剪枝的耦合矛盾讲透并给出配对变换解，长上下文推理优化可直接借鉴。

item.title: Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

双向记忆架构提升长上下文容量、绑定与选择性（Double-Take）

Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

重新思考奖励在上下文强化学习中的作用

LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution a…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

G2MLP：曲率引导保持教师图几何、修谱拟合失败模式的 GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏

GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improve…

item.title: Diffusion Precipitation Generation with Medium-range Weather Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

结合中期天气预报的扩散降水生成

Accurate daily precipitation forecasts are important for weather-sensitive decisions. Although recent Weather Foundation Models (WFMs) have achieved significant progress, they are trained on reanalysis data, which exhibit regional and intensity-dependent biases. Since retraining WFMs on observation-based targets is costly, we study Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a separately trained generator to map non-precipitation forecasts from a frozen weather model to observation-aligned daily precipitation. Its key challenges are to capture heterogeneous rainfall distributions and align daily accumulations with atmospheric signals that evolve across space and time. To address them, we train a diffusion generator conditional on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge estimates of precipitation. A multi-scale recurrent encoder summarizes atmospheric evolution, while cross-attention aligns atmospheric and precipitation features during denoising. Extensive evaluation of various backbones, including Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES, on global and regional forecasting shows improved daily precipitation accuracy and event detection, with better representatio…

item.title: Denoising Blocks, Not Tokens: Efficient Compressed Continuous Diffusion with Branching Token Realization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 扩散语言模型每步仍按 token 维护生成状态，序列多长状态就多长，限制了并行生成带来的吞吐收益。

方法 Branching Latent Diffusion（BLD）：利用连续 DLM"一个连续状态可表多个 token"的自由度，把 1024 token 压成 64 个块潜变量（16×）；每个潜变量由局部自回归分支解码、所有分支并行；潜变量分组生成、以已生成组为条件。

关键数字 同 GPU 端到端：生成 FLOPs 降低 80× 以上，吞吐比同规模 ELF-L 基线高 6× 以上；相比自回归基线吞吐高 6×+、延迟低 4×+；局部流畅度与多样性保持竞争力，长程一致性仍是挑战。

为什么值得看 把扩散从 token 级状态搬到压缩潜序列，带来数量级效率提升，代表了 DLM 架构的新方向。

item.title: Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 推理依赖专家并行，通信密集，只有带 NVLink 的数据中心 GPU 扛得住；消费级 GPU 算力相当但 PCIe 带宽弱、无 P2P 互联，通信成为严重瓶颈。

方法 CoMoE 把主机提升为主动路由枢纽：token 分发采用主机支撑的组播，共享 token 只写主机一次，消除出站传输冗余；token 合并用细粒度 token 级聚合加主机暂存缓冲，替代刚性全局同步、缓解拖尾效应。

关键数字 RTX 5090 上推理吞吐最高提升 1.46×；以 A800 仅 23.4% 的硬件成本逼近其 NVLink 性能。

为什么值得看 "主机当路由 hub"的拓扑洞察让消费卡跑 MoE 变得实际，对个人部署与隐私本地推理意义直接。

item.title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 扩散 Transformer 的 W4A4 训练后量化损失可用低秩分支缓解，但现有方法要么分开优化低秩补偿与残差量化（往往要更高秩），要么做二阶权重更新却不显式建模 4 位下很突出的激活量化误差。

方法 提出统一框架，把低秩辅助 W4A4 PTQ 建成耦合校准问题并从联合目标推导优化求解器：消去输出侧低秩因子得到「紧缩 Hessian」，剔除已被低秩分量覆盖的残差误差；同时引入激活噪声代理项抑制激活量化误差。

关键数字 五个扩散骨干上秩 4 版本在 PSNR 与 LPIPS 上全面超过秩 4 SVDQuant；在 SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell、FLUX.1-dev 上用小 8 倍的秩反超秩 32 SVDQuant，量化快至 6.25 倍；Qwen3-8B 上把 MMLU 从 61.50% 提升到 68.17%。

为什么值得看 更低秩、更低量化成本同时更好效果的 PTQ 路线，扩散模型与大语言模型通用，量化方向值得关注。

item.title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

ExpDis：把探索与优化解耦、先过滤再蒸馏的 RLVR 新策略发现框架

Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. item.title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

transformer跨头注意力的数据自适应Mahalanobis度量学习

In this paper, we propose Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention (DAMCHA), a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention (MHA) through the lens of metric learning. Standard MHA implicitly learns a static, head-wise Euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix, discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. DAMCHA addresses this limitation via two key innovations. First, it learns the full cross-head metric matrix, inducing a Mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of MHA. Second, it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function, enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. We further introduce principled regularization strategies, most notably stack-wise parameter sharing, to ensure computational efficiency and stable optimization. DAMCHA serves as a drop-in replacement for MHA and its variants in various Transformer architectures, delivering superior expressive power and learning per…

item.title: DLCB: Ahead-of-Time Compilation for Dynamic Deep Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 深度学习部署中张量形状常在编译期未知（batch 大小、序列长度、分辨率各异），而 AOT 编译 GPU 内核要峰值性能就要全静态形状，JIT 支持动态形状却要付运行时编译开销——两者矛盾。

方法 DLCB（Deep Learning Compiler Backend）用统一三层编译策略化解：形状全静态时提前生成静态 CUDA C++ 内核；张量秩已知但维度大小动态时，生成按维度参数化的 AOT 内核，一次编译、跨形状执行；秩未知时回退运行时 JIT。对动态形状 AOT，从输入程序构建形状约束系统并用求解器归约——能定死的变成内核里的硬编码常量，定不下来的变成启动时传入的内核参数，并配解释型宿主代码校验约束、计算取值。编译器与运行时嵌入 PyTorch，配自动形状泛化 pass。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体量化指标。

为什么值得看 在静态性能与动态灵活性之间给出清晰的分层编译方案，嵌入 PyTorch 的实现路径对做推理引擎/编译器的人有直接参考价值。

item.title: DEX: Digit-Level Early Exit for Energy-Efficient MSDF Neural Network Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 脑肿瘤分割的 U-Net 推理需要数十亿次乘加运算，硬件需要能动态削减计算，而非只靠固定精度或静态模型压缩。

方法 利用最高有效数位优先（MSDF）算术在结果生成前先暴露高位数位的特性，提出带两级分组处理单元（支持有符号 INT8、流内偏置累加）的量化 U-Net 加速器。四个运行时机制直接作用于输出数位流：ReLU 层精确负数提前检测（END）、分割头只做符号决策、校准的低阶数位跳过与校准剪枝；后两者离线按精度约束选定，运行时不改权重。

关键数字 BraTS 上数位周期减少 38.38%，73 个留出病例平均 Dice 80.58%（浮点模型 81.20%）；仅精确机制即减 18.79% 且不改输出。45nm 工艺下 500MHz、0.858mm²、每 192×192 patch 0.726mJ；八路输出加速器预计 16.6ms、1.67mJ。

为什么值得看 数位级提前退出的完整软硬协同实现，精确与近似机制分离的设计对高能效医疗影像推理硬件很有参考性。

item.title: DADP: Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning, A Reverse Hebbian-Inspired Structural Pruning Method
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现代神经网络严重过参数化，而现有剪枝方法多依赖事后幅值阈值或静态初始化启发式，常需逐层手工设定稀疏度目标或昂贵的重训练。

方法 DADP 是一种受逆向赫布规则启发的结构化可塑性机制：训练过程中用突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积衡量连接重要性，用单一全局阈值代替逐层预算，沿网络深度动态分配稀疏度，自然诱导神经元级与通道级剪枝。

关键数字 在 MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF、MiniBERT 上匹配或超过 Magnitude、SNIP、RigL；ResNet-18 在 99% 稀疏度下保持 73.67% 准确率（稠密基线 76.06%）。基于矩阵的香农熵与有效秩测量证实极端稀疏下未发生表示坍缩。

为什么值得看 免逐层调参、训练中动态完成的结构剪枝，且对表示多样性有量化验证，是剪枝方向一个有实证支撑的新机制。

item.title: D-SLR: The Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank Decomposition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 矩阵压缩重建长期默认截断 SVD；要再加行稀疏分量降低残差，现有联合求解方法往往依赖迭代求解器和正则参数调优。

方法 提出不交行稀疏加低秩分解（D-SLR）：每行只能「原样存储」或「由低秩近似表示」，二选一。作者证明在平方误差下该限制零代价——每个非平凡秩与存储行数组合下，不交形式都能以更少的参数达到联合最优。零存储行时退化为截断 SVD，因此同成本下永不更差。整个误差-参数权衡网格只需三次 SVD，无需调参，并给出无假设的逐点误差下界作为可选方案的可计算「证书」。

关键数字 在 LLM 嵌入表、网络流量、高光谱图像等真实数据上验证了相对截断 SVD 的收益；摘要未给出具体百分比数字。

为什么值得看 闭式、免调参、直接替换截断 SVD 且自带最优性证书，是很实用的一套矩阵压缩基础工具。

item.title: CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 最好的 2-bit 权重量化器（QTIP、Proteus）每步解码都要撤销随机正交旋转，且 Hessian 只通过误差反馈进入编码——作者指出其信息被浪费了：误差反馈把损失变成按 Hessian LDL 分解对角加权的逐坐标舍入误差，而现有量化器算出了这些权重却从不使用。

方法 把这些曲率权重直接放进 Viterbi 分支度量，让格码搜索在原生基底下跟随曲率；理论上证明"原生加权"与"旋转"互为替代。据此构建无旋转 trellis 编解码器 CurveTQ，配因子化尺度场、闭式分位表与逐编码块起始状态。

关键数字 2-bit 下比 QTIP/Proteus 平均下游精度高 1–3 分（三个 4–8B Instruct 模型）；据作者所知是首个 35B MoE 上的格码结果；无旋转可撤销，解码器在所有测试 batch 与位宽下最快。

为什么值得看 把一个"大家都算却没人读"的量变成核心机制，还顺手解释了旋转为何有效，理论与系统双赢。
