item.title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

面向语义物理现实的四张量注意力模型

We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: $C_4$-Equivariant Flow Matching on Anisotropic Power-Diagram Graphs for Microstructure Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-09　分类：论文PDF

各向异性幂图上 C4 等变流匹配做微结构生成

Acquiring realistic microstructure data through Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) is costly and time consuming, often relying on specialised equipment. As microstructures strongly influence material properties, generating realistic samples is essential for modelling the behaviour of polycrystalline materials. We introduce a generative model for synthesising realistic polycrystalline microstructures using flow matching and graph neural networks. By representing microstructures as anisotropic power diagrams, our model learns a compact geometric parametrisation and can render generated samples at arbitrary pixel resolution. A $C_4$-equivariant architecture incorporates rotational symmetry directly into the model, ensuring that rotations of the input noise produce corresponding rotations of the generated microstructure. We also demonstrate how training-free guidance can be used to generate complex microstructures, based on user defined objective function. In particular, we generate microstructures resembling a copper weld, cast metal slab, 3D-printed stainless steel and heterogeneous lamella titanium.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: VortexSynth: Profile-guided benchmark reconstruction for GPU architecture research
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GPU 架构研究需要代表性基准，但厂商定制负载与闭源核无法在研究架构上运行，如何自动化迁移？ 方法：VortexSynth 用剖析引导的基准重建：profiling 选热点核、用目标语言（编程模型）合成实现、做输出等价性验证，并用翻译的代理实现度量剖析签名差距，交给 agent 迭代精化。 关键数字：在开源 ISA GPGPU「Vortex」、机器人领域上评测，所有活跃核对的输出等价检查全部通过；案例研究显示迭代精化能缩小剖析距离。 为什么值得看：把「负载移植」变成 agent 驱动的自动化流程，架构研究与新硬件评测的基准构造成本有望大幅下降。

item.title: Transformer-Based Masked Diffusion Models Provably Learn Distributions with Latent Structure
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

基于transformer的掩码扩散模型可证明学习带潜结构的分布

Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete data by iteratively unmasking multiple tokens in parallel using a learned mask predictor. Their output carries two errors: parallelization error due to parallel sampling, and estimation error from the mask predictor learned with finite samples. Existing theory treats these errors separately, and the available statistical bounds typically scale with the number $V^L$ of length-$L$ sequences over a vocabulary of size $V$, suffering from the curse of dimensionality. In this work, we establish end-to-end statistical guarantees showing that transformer-based MDMs learn structured distributions with a sample complexity governed by their latent structure. Specifically, we model this structure through mixtures of hidden Markov trees, which capture latent dependencies within components and heterogeneity across components. When the data distribution is well approximated by such a mixture, a transformer-based MDM with parallel unmasking schedules achieves $\varepsilon$-accurate sampling in KL divergence with $\widetilde{O}(LK_{\mathrm{par}}/\varepsilon)$ training samples, where $K_{\mathrm{par}}$ is polynomial in $L$, $V$, the number of hidden s…

item.title: The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

随机特征MPNN跨图尺寸的表达能力刻画

Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Tandem Queues with Hybrid Abandonment in Heavy Traffic
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

混合放弃机制下串联排队的重交通理论分析

Hybrid-abandonment systems, where jobs abandon from certain stages of service but not others, occur frequently in medical, service, and computing systems. Abandonment affects the heavy-traffic behavior of both the stages with and without abandonment. In contrast to existing heavy-traffic works that focus on cases where there is abandonment at either all stages or no stages, we focus on the heavy-traffic behavior for these hybrid-abandonment systems. We provide the first heavy-traffic characterization of the second queue length in a two-stage tandem queue with abandonment only in the first stage. We characterize the scaled mean of the second stage queue length and prove that the scaled second queue length is asymptotically exponentially distributed and asymptotically independent of the first stage queue length. We derive our results by analyzing Markovian arrival process queues with countably infinite phases. We do this by extending techniques used to analyze queues with Markov-modulated arrivals to the broader class of infinite Markovian arrival process queues. item.title: SynAct: Synergistic Active Feedback Learning for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

LLM agent的协同主动反馈学习（SynAct）

LLM agents executing multi-step workflows fail in two fundamentally different ways: recoverable slips, which further attempts can repair, and knowledge gaps, which retrying cannot resolve. Expert feedback can address the latter, but expert attention is scarce. The key challenge is therefore not whether to ask for feedback, but where feedback can change the outcome. Existing approaches either avoid expert feedback, allowing agents to reinforce their own errors, or allocate feedback at the task level without identifying consequential decisions. We present SynAct, an active learning framework that treats expert attention as the binding constraint and allocates feedback at the level of individual decisions. SynAct ranks decisions by the mutual information between the selected action and the terminal outcome across repeated rollouts, queries an expert at the highest-value decisions, and distills the resulting corrections into transferable rules that the agent can reuse without expert access at deployment. We theoretically characterize what this signal identifies under finite repeated sampling: with k rollouts and at least m observations per action, outcome-constant decisions have zero m…

item.title: Static Gradient Attribution Underperforms a Density-Matched Random Mask on Loss-Based Forgetting Within LoRA B-Matrix
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

静态梯度归因在基于损失的遗忘任务上不敌密度匹配随机掩码

Parameter-efficient continual learning updates a restricted subset of adapter parameters to incorporate sequential tasks while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Gradient attribution is a common rule for selecting that subset, but it requires an additional backward pass over calibration data. We identify a parameter-pool confound in comparisons between initialization-time gradient masks and unrestricted random masks under standard zero-initialized LoRA ($B=0$): the gradient with respect to $A$ is identically zero ($\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial A=0$), so gradient masks select strictly from the $B$ matrix whereas unrestricted random masks draw from both $A$ and $B$. Such a comparison changes both the selection rule and the candidate parameter pool. Isolating the selection criterion by restricting both approaches to the same parameter pool, we find a negative result: a uniform random mask consistently achieves lower loss-based backward transfer than gradient attribution across seven seeds on Qwen2.5-3B. The effect is concentrated on the medical task, which contributes 80\% of the aggregate; code and math move in the same direction, and legal shows no reliable difference. This advantage…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

部分观测场神经代理的输入尺寸设计：空间上下文还是记忆

Neural surrogates that forecast a physical field from sparse, noisy sensors read a window of nearby sensors and a history of past snapshots. Practitioners choose both by comparing fitted models with each other. Such comparisons cannot tell a model's shortfall from missing information. We measure the trade-off between window and history against the Bayes-optimal error of the same readings. An exact Gaussian analysis shows that noisy or sparse observation of a field with local dynamics makes the optimal forecast read distant sensors only through spatial correlation. On a forced linear field with a known optimum, trained models that read only the window come within 1% of it. We then train such models on viscous Burgers flow and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, with every deciding comparison fixed before any test evaluation. In every field except KS, eight snapshots remove a smaller fraction of the one-snapshot error as the lead time, the number of steps to the forecast target, grows. In KS, for windows up to one correlation length, they remove a larger fraction. This lead-time inversion persists across sensor densities, three architectures and a two-dimensional domain. …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: STAPLE: Static Sparse Upcycling of Pretrained Checkpoints via Embedding Modules
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：稀疏预训练昂贵，现有稀疏升级多走 MoE 路线（专家同质化、样本效率低），能否用静态稀疏记忆给已训好的稠密检查点「扩容」？ 方法：STAPLE 在 STEM 基础上改造：保留原 FFN 上投影，把 token 索引嵌入作为残差通路注入，保住预训练计算并学习互补的 token 级信息；配合主机卸载，GPU 上只缓存约 5% 最高频嵌入。 关键数字：OLMo-2 1B 上较继续稠密训练 HumanEval +4.27、MBPP +2.80、GSM8K +2.27、DROP +1.65；比 MoE 升级基线均分更高且解码快 2×、显存与每 token 能耗减半；生成吞吐量与稠密基线差距 1.5% 以内。 为什么值得看：给「不想从头稀疏预训练」的团队提供一条样本高效的升级路径，吞吐代价几乎为零。

item.title: NV-Tesseract-AD: Curriculum-Enhanced Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

课程增强条件扩散做多变量时序异常检测

We propose NV-Tesseract-AD, a curriculum learning-enhanced conditional diffusion framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Our central hypothesis is that reconstruction difficulty can be explicitly structured along two complementary axes, masking severity and diffusion noise level, and that training from easier to harder tasks along both axes simultaneously stabilizes optimization and improves residual discriminability. We integrate a Transformer-based diffusion backbone with a three-stage dual curriculum over masking ratios and diffusion timesteps, retaining anomalous samples throughout training and relying on structured corruption to drive self-supervised representation learning. We evaluate NV-Tesseract-AD under two regimes: in-distribution training on the TSB-UAD-M corpus and strict zero-shot transfer to ten EasyTSAD benchmark families without per-dataset tuning. The dual-axis curriculum produces masking-invariant reconstruction, confirmed by a near-zero loss gap between complementary masking strategies within the first training stage, and yields an approximately 3.7-fold improvement in F1 and a 56 percent reduction in MSE relative to a non-curriculum baseline. …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Kronecker Product Attention: Memory-Efficient KV Compression via Structured Factorization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：KV 缓存随序列长度线性膨胀，MQA/GQA/MLA/TPA 各有表达力或位置编码的代价，能否两全？ 方法：提出 Kronecker 积注意力（KPA），把 key/value 表示为紧凑、随 token 变化的矩阵因子的 Kronecker 积之和；严格泛化 TPA（秩一向量外积是其退化情形），并设计匹配的结构化 RoPE 算子，免去 MLA 式解耦 RoPE 分支。 关键数字：同训练条件下在 4 个模型规模、9 个下游基准上持平或超过 TPA/MHA/MQA/GQA/MLA，KV 缓存压缩最高 10×；头切分方式可设计期调节压缩-精度权衡。 为什么值得看：把「结构化因子化」做到比 TPA 更一般的形式，是 KV 压缩架构演进里少见的严格泛化工作。

item.title: Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

摊销条件可解释性的核化参数敏感度图

Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attrib…

item.title: KITE: A Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder for Time-Series Event Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

时序事件预测的知识注入时间编码器（KITE）

Forecasting rare, high-cost events in multivariate time-series systems is hard because their precursors are seldom observed, so a purely data-driven model has little to learn from. The engineers who run these systems, however, hold knowledge that precedes such events, information absent from the scarce labels. We call this a semantic prior and inject it into a self-supervised event forecaster through two switchable mechanisms, a covariate mechanism and an attention-bias mechanism, each the identity at its null, so one architecture serves every prior type with no per-dataset architecture search. A prior helps when it supplies information the observed window does not already contain: in a short context an informative prior beats no prior in-domain (pooled h-AUROC over the no-prior baseline: a periodicity clock +14%, p<0.001; a conservation residual +47% at a 0.25 label fraction), and a working prior transfers out-of-domain (+53%), substituting for feature transfer, while priors the window already recovers stay inert and the attention-bias mechanism shows no measurable gain. KITE is a switchable, attributable route to contextual conditioning, and a substrate for scaling toward cross-d…

item.title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

协议监督预训练做跨队列血糖预测迁移（GlucoPRISM）

Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. item.title: Expert-level detection of low-voltage intervals in EEG as a robust biomarker of neonatal encephalopathy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

EEG低电压区间专家级检测作为新生儿脑病鲁棒生物标记

Background: Discontinuity in neonatal EEG is a critical marker of brain dysfunction but can be difficult to quantify visually. Inter-burst intervals (IBIs) are a key characteristic of discontinuity, yet their definition does not easily translate to AI detection. Objectives: To introduce low-voltage intervals (LVIs), defined exclusively by amplitude and duration, as a context-independent alternative to IBIs, develop an AI detection method for LVIs, and assess their clinical utility as a marker of brain injury. Methods: We developed a ConvNeXt model to detect LVIs and compared its performance with existing methods. We then tested the clinical relevance of detected LVIs across four applications: 1) grading background EEG abnormalities on an open benchmark dataset, 2) classifying clinical hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) grades and comparing with a normal EEG dataset, 3) seizure prediction, and 4) association with seizure burden. Results: For training and validation, 654 hours of per-channel EEG from 123 neonates were reviewed and 51,162 LVIs were annotated. On held-out validation, ConvNeXt had an AUC of 0.996 and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.926. Model-reader agreemen…

item.title: Efficient Learning of Survival Analysis Models Under Outcome-Dependent Truncation and Censoring
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

结局依赖删失/截断下高效学习生存分析模型

Modern machine learning models are typically trained on data assumed to be representative of the predictive tasks the model will face in the future, but practical datasets violate this assumption. We focus on outcome-dependent truncation in which an observation appears in the training data depending on its label. Our work connects two largely distinct literatures: efficient learning under truncation and survival analysis. Existing methods for truncated survival analysis do not characterize the optimization landscape and instead rely on iterative procedures such as expectation maximization. We address this gap and prove that Cox regression can be efficiently learned under truncated and right-censored data using first-order optimization when the baseline hazard is known (despite nonconvexity). In contrast, when the baseline hazard is learned jointly, we construct identifiable and correctly specified models whose negative log-likelihood contains strict suboptimal local minima. On experiments with four survival datasets, we show that accounting for truncation reduces the prediction bias induced by naive Cox regression and extends to neural networks. We also show orders of magnitude spe…

item.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

高效、稳定、可扩展的扩散模型强化（DiffusionART）

Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on Hunyu…

item.title: Deploying RDMA for Large-Scale Inference and Training Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产环境大规模训练/推理中，RDMA 为什么不能「只换 TCP」就用好？ 方法：总结字节跳动参数服务器系统部署 ByteExpress 的三条经验：跨应用与传输层的缓冲管理、连接/接收容量/在途数据的协同管理、传输层之上的恢复机制；系统组合 RDMA 感知分配器、零拷贝、QP 复用、接收信用流控、软件发送窗口与 RPC 辅助恢复。 关键数字：推理取参数延迟均值降 35.7%、P99 降 43.7%，CPU 总用量降 10.69%；训练参数推送 P99 最高降 74.0%，运行时无 PFC 暂停。 为什么值得看：罕见的一线生产 RDMA 部署复盘，三条经验对自建推理/训练集群的通信层设计直接可用。

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：生产环境大规模训练/推理中，RDMA 为什么不能「只换 TCP」就用好？ 方法：总结字节跳动参数服务器系统部署 ByteExpress 的三条经验：跨应用与传输层的缓冲管理、连接/接收容量/在途数据的协同管理、传输层之上的恢复机制；系统组合 RDMA 感知分配器、零拷贝、QP 复用、接收信用流控、软件发送窗口与 RPC 辅助恢复。 关键数字：推理取参数延迟均值降 35.7%、P99 降 43.7%，CPU 总用量降 10.69%；训练参数推送 P99 最高降 74.0%，运行时无 PFC 暂停。 为什么值得看：罕见的一线生产 RDMA 部署复盘，三条经验对自建推理/训练集群的通信层设计直接可用。

item.title: CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：免训练缓存复用加速扩散 Transformer 时，哪些步该真正算、哪些步可以复用缓存？ 方法：发现浅层探针的绝对变化同时受输入轨迹位移和网络响应强度影响，不能直接反映缓存风险；将其按轨迹位移归一化得到「单位轨迹位移的方向增益」，据此在线识别高风险复用步并回退到完整去噪计算（CacheScope），无需训练、梯度或离线调度优化。 关键数字：在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、Open-Sora 1.2 上最高 3.57× 加速，中位 LPIPS 较最强探针基线最多降 70.1%。 为什么值得看：把「精确计算步放在哪」置于「重建器多复杂」之上，信号设计思路对推理加速普遍有借鉴意义。

item.title: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Large Language Model via Hypergraph Message Passing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

超图消息传递实现拜占庭鲁棒的联邦大语言模型

Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) are promising to deliver privacy-preserving, collaborative intelligence. The decentralized training process is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that corrupt semantic consistency and factual resilience through malicious model updates. This paper presents a new resilience strategy that prevents semantically corrupted knowledge from propagating during federated aggregation. A defense problem is formulated to jointly maximize global accuracy and suppress manipulated model updates, enabling trustworthy knowledge aggregation without accessing private local data. To strengthen the resilience of FedLLMs, we develop a novel Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE) framework, where low-rank model updates are represented as nodes in a hypergraph and high-order semantic relationships among multiple agents are exploited through iterative message passing. By leveraging historical checkpoints and cross-agent relational reasoning, HMP-GAE identifies and suppresses semantically inconsistent updates while preserving knowledge alignment among agents throughout federated training. HMP-GAE is implemented using Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.2 as pretrained F…

item.title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-08　分类：论文PDF

从净智能电表反推表后光伏出力的部署 regimes 与运营影响

Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-…
